source: Anthropic first-party API rates from the claude-api reference (cached 2026-06-24). Verify against https://claude.com/pricing before relying on these. Add models here as the agents under test start using them.

cache_pricing.note: Each model's cache_write_5m and cache_read below are its base input rate times these multipliers. We use the 5-minute TTL (short eval conversations), so cache_write_5m is the write rate. Read multiplier is 0.1x for standard models; per-model exceptions from the docs: Opus 5.5 read = 0.05x, Fable/Mythos 5.1 read = 0.025x (reflected in the per-model cache_read below).
